URL: https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/5/14/uk-health-secretary-wes-streeting-resigns-from-government

(Cached previously on 14 May; continued relevance for 15 May morning brief)

Streeting resignation aftermath:
- Prime Minister Starmer appointed James Murray, former Chief Secretary to the Treasury, as new Health Secretary
- Lucy Rigby named Chief Secretary to the Treasury (taking over Murray's previous role)
- Appointment made late Thursday 14 May 2026

Streeting's resignation letter direct quote:
- "It is now clear that you will not lead the Labour Party into the next general election"
- Cited "unprecedented" local council election losses
- Said it would be "dishonourable and unprincipled" to remain in government

Leadership situation:
- 81 of 403 Labour MPs (20%) needed to unite behind one challenger to trigger formal contest
- No consensus among Labour MPs on who should replace Starmer
- Potential challengers: Streeting, Angela Rayner, Andy Burnham

Starmer response:
- Number 10: PM "purely focused on governing", "getting on with the job"
- Chancellor Rachel Reeves urged colleagues not to risk economy through leadership challenge
